text_cards.caption: ACE
text_cards.description: Two characters become better friends, what happened to cause this to occur?

text_cards.caption: TWO
text_cards.description: An unattended situation becomes problematic and scary.  What is it? How does it go awry

text_cards.caption: THREE
text_cards.description: \small A character has something they wish for, but it may be hard to obtain. Describe what they wish for. OR A character is given an unexpected opportunity, but there is some major roadblock to taking advantage of it. Describe how they approach this opportunity

text_cards.caption: FOUR
text_cards.description: \small A character is asked to make a choice, even though it goes against their own wishes or values. What effects does this have? OR they decide not to make this choice, even though that goes against the wishes of a person that is important to them. What effects does this have?

text_cards.caption: FIVE
text_cards.description: \small A character hears about an accident or bad event and has a personal reaction. What happened? What is their reaction? OR they hear about something special or wonderful that has happened to someone else. What happened? How does it affect them?

text_cards.caption: SIX
text_cards.description: Someone new arrives. Who? Why have they come? Are they in distress? OR Someone who leaves the community? Who? What are they looking for?

text_cards.caption: SEVEN
text_cards.description: A charismatic youngster convinces many to help them with an elaborate scheme. What is it? Who joins their endeavors?

text_cards.caption: EIGHT
text_cards.description: Two people or a group of people are thrown in together to achieve a goal. What is it? Are they able to work well together?

text_cards.caption: NINE
text_cards.description: A headstrong character tries to convince the community to change their current path. What consequences does this have? Or how are they prevented from doing this?

text_cards.caption: TEN
text_cards.description: \small A contingent within the community demands to be heard. Who are they? What are they asking for? OR A contingent within the community have acted on their frustrations. What did they damage, and why did they damage it? Is it permanent?

text_cards.caption: JACK
text_cards.description: Something happens that should be taken as a warning. What is it? *or* something feels good and different. What is it?

text_cards.caption: QUEEN
text_cards.description: Describe a group at the edge of a community? Are they currently interacting with the main community now? If so, explain how.

text_cards.caption: KING
text_cards.description: \small What group has the highest status in your community? What must people do to gain inclusion in this group? OR Describe the family of one of the characters. How do they get along with each other? How do their dynamics affect the character?
